_doc: Hidden-lemon recon variance (slice #162 — the 'B mid' dopamine layer from #182). The realized recon cost is rolled at vehicle acquisition as estimate × bucketMultiplier, where the bucket distribution starts at 'baseProb' and is reshaped by three independent gates: condition × source-reliability-band × mileage-band. Tail factors multiply the per-bucket probabilities; the 'within' bucket is the renormalization sink. The catastrophic bucket carries multiplier 2.00–4.00 (the AC's '100–300% over' = +100% to +300%). Source reliability is bucketed against the per-save AuctionSourceReliability draws (#160).
